display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 共用双恢复分支实增益融合筛查
description: 两个数据集都输入各自合法冻结的实增益与 R17 两个恢复结果，由同一物理残差与逐频点实增益核心融合，独立源域训练与筛查。
authorization: 用户要求两个数据集使用通用融合方法，优先 R02/R07/R17；显存充足立即启动并保护其他 owner。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI CUDA FP32 / TF32 off, CPU independent scorer

data.contract_ref: lora_rx5_main_v1:392005; ManySig Main original 7/63/30 F0 seed392005; VALIDATED_ONCE source caches
data.representation: one SharedTwoPriorGain class and mathematical rule; LoRa 8x1024 and WiSig 8x32, dataset-specific real-gain/R17 adapters and separately trained weights
data.physical_ids_ref: existing first cross-data screen physical IDs, same paired channel observations
data.exposure: same source V RX panels and historical comparisons repeatedly exposed by prior development; no target input or truth

permissions.claim_scope: Same source-only loss and separate head weights. LoRa real-gain expert inherited authorized E104-guided supervised/pseudolabel training; WiSig real-gain expert is F-free. No F weights or TX labels accessed for new head training; frozen original classifiers only during prediction; source V truth only after all row predictions freeze.

checkpoint.initialization: Zero-initialize the same two-gain core independently per dataset, each initialized output equal to its dataset's frozen real-gain expert; no cross-dataset weight transfer.

sources.role: WiSig original full R17 and action
LoRa E104 real-gain screen comparison only
WiSig frozen DURA v1 same-packet screen predictions
frozen same-ID LoRa-trained R69 architecture adaptation; distinct from original WiSig DURA v1 weights

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source final step 2000. LoRa hard-scene net >=1 in each fixed half and clean >=-1 versus every available same-packet control including LoRa R69 adaptation. WiSig each half net >=2 and clean >=-2 against each control including fixed DURA v1. Original fixed WiSig DURA v1 checkpoint has no lawful matched LoRa transfer; disclose as unavailable, not substitute cross-data score.

execution.gpu_policy: User latest says start when sufficient VRAM. Two distinct GPUs, each >=8192 MiB free at launch and at most one worker from this run per card; preserve all other owner processes. Actual total GPU occupancy recorded by preflight.
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected run on provenance/data-contract mismatch, occupied immutable output, no source-only checkpoint smoke, nonfinite loss/gradient, prediction matrix mismatch, query or truth-boundary violation; preserve partial artifacts and all other processes.

rows.method: same SharedTwoPriorGain combining frozen real-gain estimate, R17 estimate and R17 physical backprojection

data_overrides.training: U_s only; no TX or classifier

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.
rows.budget_ref: 2000 updates, batch 4, U_s only, no F or TX

rows.method: same SharedTwoPriorGain combining frozen real-gain estimate, R17 estimate and R17 physical backprojection

data_overrides.training: U_s only; no TX or classifier

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.
rows.budget_ref: 2000 updates, batch 24, U_s only, no F or TX

notes: Both datasets use the same SharedTwoPriorGain architecture, same real-gain mixing formula, same source-only loss and final-step rule; packet lengths, frozen expert implementations and independently trained weights differ.

LoRa frozen real-gain expert used authorized E104 supervised guidance and U pseudolabels; WiSig real-gain expert was independently trained without F or TX. Their historical costs remain distinct from new head cost.
L = IQ MSE + 0.3 spectral error + 1.5 clean retention versus frozen real-gain output. Per-packet normalization and expert output scales match training and inference.

Source V panels were repeatedly exposed; no target signal, target truth or target statistics are used in training or threshold fitting. Full tests only after preregistered screen passes; all predictions before independent target scoring.
